name: bauhaus-riot
vibe: A print poster that came alive. Cream paper with a faint dot grid, primary-color geometry — red, cobalt and signal yellow with hard black borders and offset shadows — and uppercase Archivo Black headlines that STAMP onto the page like a printing press. Motion is mechanical and joyful: curtain wipes, bouncing shapes, sticker slaps, red X strikes, letter tiles. No gradients, no glow, no blur — ink on paper, moving. For launches, manifestos, sales and anything that should shout beautifully.
